Workflow.Name: Verify contact address with PostGrid (sample)
Workflow.Description: Runs when the address of a contact changes: checks it with PostGrid Address Verification (US/Canada) and International Address Verification, writes the verified address back to the standard address columns, and adds a note with everything PostGrid returned. Part of the PostGrid sample app.
